purpose: Gameplay alternatives concept preview; generated imagery, not implemented gameplay or engine screenshots.

images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / stylized-concept.
Create ONE polished widescreen 16:9 in-game screenshot concept for a small-budget PC indie game, "EchoStation — 通讯谈判经营". This is a playable-looking game screen, not a poster, not a collage, not an infographic.
Setting: a compact remote ecological observation station administrator's cabin. First-person seated view across a practical desk into ONE small modular room. Limited reusable assets: metal shelves, two identical supply crates, simple wall pipes, a window with foggy cold mountains, a desk terminal. Echo is a charming small wheeled research robot beside the desk, with two wheels, a tilting sensor head and a calm BLUE indicator, no human face. No human NPCs, no weapons.
Visual target: achievable Unity URP indie graphics, simple clean geometry, soft stylized realistic PBR surfaces, restrained wear, cool blue and gray with a modest warm desk lamp and small orange warning light. Attractive careful lighting but no extravagant clutter or huge exterior vista. The room should feel cozy, isolated and believable. High image clarity.
Composition: the 3D room and Echo occupy the left 58% and remain clearly visible. A crisp integrated terminal-style negotiation interface occupies the right 42%, flat enough to read, with translucent charcoal blue panels, excellent Chinese typography, clear spacing. At top a thin resource strip. At bottom-right a prominent free-text input. A small paper-like pending agreement card conveys concrete game consequences.
Render the following short Chinese UI copy accurately, with hierarchy; do not add paragraphs of tiny illegible text:
Top left title "ECHO STATION"
Top strip "第 03 天"  "电力 38"  "食物 12"  "电池 4"
Right panel title "通讯 · 北线运输队"
Contact message "我们需要两块电池，可以用食物交换。"
Player message "食物足够了。能替我运回北侧设备吗？"
Contact reply "可以。一块先付，另一块交货后结算。"
Agreement card "待确认协议"  "支出：电池 ×2"  "回报：设备运输"  "明日交付"
Buttons "确认协议" and "继续协商"
Input "输入你的提议……"
Small Echo subtitle near robot "我已记录条件，等待你的确认。"
Constraints: realistic game UI proportions, easily legible selected text, no illustrated human portrait, no external brands, no promotional slogans, no comic panels. Focus on a visually appealing ONE-room game that clearly communicates natural-language bargaining and resource management.

Use case: ui-mockup / stylized-concept.
Create ONE polished widescreen 16:9 actual-play-looking PC indie game screenshot concept for "EchoStation — 回合制叙事冒险". It must be a distinctly DIFFERENT presentation from a first-person 3D room: a beautiful low-asset-cost 2D narrative game interface using ONE fixed scene image, a simple route map and text interaction. Not a poster, not a collage, no multiple screenshot frames.
Theme: a quiet science-fiction expedition with the small wheeled assistant robot Echo, traveling between remote observation outposts. No combat. The player proposes creative actions by typing; the world has persistent resources and turns. The current encounter is a storm-bound mountain supply outpost where the player can negotiate repair work in exchange for shelter.
Visual style: coherent cool blue/gray palette, restrained warm amber light, sophisticated clean dark interface, cinematic but achievable indie look. Central fixed background is visibly simple low-poly PBR 3D scenery rendered as a still: one modular prefabricated supply hut, compact gate, a few reusable crates, simple snow-rock terrain, blue dusk, small warm lit window; small Echo silhouette with blue sensor by the gate. No detailed crowds, no high-end character faces, no painted epic panorama. The same simple assets could be reused in other scenes.
Layout: left narrow sidebar ~19% with a schematic node-and-line route map and small resource indicators. Right main area ~81%: upper half a wide fixed scene background with the encounter title; lower half a calm, generously spaced narrative transcript and player action entry. Clear playable interface, exceptionally good Chinese typography. Use short accurate Chinese text:
Main title "山口补给站"
Turn badge "回合 08"
Map labels "观测站"  "山口"  "北线营地"
Resources "电量 62%"  "补给 3"
Narrative "风雪封住了山路。站点管理员愿意提供住宿，但要求一份燃料。"
Player action card "我想修好他们的发电机，换取今晚的住宿。"
Outcome card "管理员接受了提议。你需要消耗一套维修零件。"
Small Echo line "零件足够。是否确认这项交换？"
Buttons "确认行动"  "换个办法"
Wide bottom input "你准备怎么做？输入行动或对话……"
Bottom hint "Enter 提交"
Constraints: actual game screen with UI as the main experience, wide landscape ratio, no gamepad hardware, no mockup laptop, no faces, no firearms, no giant illustrated battle scene. Make it enticing despite a small reusable art asset budget. Clearly communicate turn-based emergent story and natural-language actions, with a single reusable fixed background and a simple route map.
